## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹², hole n = −1.2×10¹²

**Raw first (fig 1), then onset + 1/B FFT vs the forward model (fig 2).** Channel: sr1 (B_1–B_2), gain-divided, I_bias = 10 nA, 50 µV FS = 5 kΩ; both runs peak ≤ 12 % FS — no clipping.

**Run 6 (electron, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T) — clean and decisive-shaped.** Dominant tone **7.1 T** with SNR ≈ 40, matching the model's ABAB light pocket (7.31 T at this n) to 3 %. Tones at 14.1 / 29.5 T are its 2× / 4× harmonics. The **22.1 T tone is the fork**: it sits within its own δF (1.6 T) of both 3×7.1 = 21.3 T (harmonic) and the ABAB heavy pocket (model 25.8 T) — single-record unresolvable, exactly the recipe's "never eat the heavy tone with a ratio-only screen" case (ABAB heavy/light ratio is 3.50 at this n). Luttinger: 7.1 + 22.1 = 29.2 T = 0.88·F_L — closes at a global density scale 0.88, inside the 0.8–1.2 lever-arm prior; 7.1 alone (≪ F_L) cannot close it. **Onset is censored at the 0.3 T analysis edge**, but the record below 1 T is a 50 mT grid that under-Nyquists the 7.1 T tone (< 2 pts/period at ≤ 0.7 T), so the sub-1 T "tones" at 3.0/4.2/5.1/9.5 T are alias-suspect and the honest onset statement is **≤ ~1 T, unpinned below** — the fan's B_lo needs the low-field extension (next cell).

**Run 7 (hole, n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T) — the designed-for near-CNP exception regime, uninformative for the call.** Broad merged humps (model ABAB pair 5.9/6.5 T — close and balanced, beat-like on this record; ABCA m* ≈ 1.1 mₑ is LK-dead at T_e ≈ 8 K). No tone read survives the harmonic screen. As priced in the proposal: a preview, not evidence.

**Verdict for Step 4: fan on the electron side.** n-window where the templates separate and trajectories decide (heavy/light ratio drifts 4.8 → 3.5 over n = 2 → 3.2×10¹² while a harmonic stays at 3.0; model table printed below is the design authority). Inherit sr1 50 µV; Δ(1/B) ≤ 1/(3·F_L(n_max)) ≈ 0.010 T⁻¹.

# Runs 6-7: SdH spot checks at D = 0 -> onset, tones, model overlay (fan design inputs)
import sys
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import (open_run, resolve_channels, sdh_onset, sdh_fft,
                           luttinger_frequency, SdhOnsetError)
sys.path.insert(0, "/home/hera/measurement_env/hera/models/tetralayer_fs_count")
import fs_count_b0 as fsm

I_BIAS = 1.0 / 100e6            # sr1 drive 1.0 V / 100 MOhm
R_FS = 50e-6 / I_BIAS           # 5 kOhm full scale
runs = {6: dict(n=+3.2e16, label="electron n=+3.2e12"),
        7: dict(n=-1.2e16, label="hole n=-1.2e12")}

# --- fig 1: RAW, both runs ---
fig1, ax1 = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 3.6))
for k, (rid, info) in enumerate(runs.items()):
    r = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    ch = [c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta) if c.cid == "sr1"][0]
    B, R = r.col("magnet_field"), r.col(ch.col) / ch.gain / I_BIAS
    o = np.argsort(B); info["B"], info["R"] = B[o], R[o]
    ax1[k].plot(info["B"], info["R"], lw=0.6)
    ax1[k].set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="Rxx (Ohm)", title=f"run {rid} raw — {info['label']}")
    print(f"run {rid}: R {info['R'].min():.0f}..{info['R'].max():.0f} Ohm "
          f"({info['R'].max()/R_FS:.1%} of 5 kOhm FS)")
fig1.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# --- fig 2: onset + FFT vs model ---
fig2, ax2 = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for k, (rid, info) in enumerate(runs.items()):
    B, R, n = info["B"], info["R"], info["n"]
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(n))
    print(f"\n=== run {rid} — {info['label']}, F_L = {FL:.1f} T ===")
    try:
        on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=R_FS); print(on.summary())
        b_lo = on.onset_b
    except SdhOnsetError as e:
        print(f"SdhOnsetError: {e}"); b_lo = 1.5
    ax = ax2[k]
    for cut, st in ((max(b_lo, 0.5), "-"), (max(b_lo * 1.4, b_lo + 0.5), "--")):
        freqs, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, B.max()))
        ax.plot(freqs, spec[0], st, lw=1, label=f"cut {cut:.2f} T")
    ax.axvline(FL, color="k", ls=":", label=f"F_L {FL:.1f} T")
    _, ab = fsm.abab_fs(n)
    for F, _ in ab:
        ax.axvline(F, color="tab:red", ls="--", alpha=0.6)
    Fa = fsm.abca_fs(n)[4]
    ax.axvline(Fa, color="tab:green", ls="--", alpha=0.6)
    print("model ABAB (F, m*):", [(round(F, 2), round(m, 3)) for F, m in fsm.abab_mstar(n)],
          f" | ABCA F = {Fa:.1f} T, m* = {fsm.abca_mstar(n)[1]:.3f}")
    ax.set(xlim=(0, FL * 1.6), xlabel="F (T)", ylabel="FFT amp",
           title=f"run {rid} FFT in 1/B (red = ABAB, green = ABCA)")
    ax.legend(fontsize=7)
fig2.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# --- model F(n) design table (electron side) — the fan's design authority ---
print("\nmodel F(n), electron side —  n(e12)  F_L    light  heavy  heavy/light  3xlight  m*_l/m*_h")
for nn in (1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.2):
    nm = nn * 1e16
    (_, ab), ms = fsm.abab_fs(nm), fsm.abab_mstar(nm)
    fl_, fh_ = ab[0][0], ab[-1][0]
    print(f"  {nn:4.1f}  {float(luttinger_frequency(nm)):5.1f}  {fl_:5.2f}  {fh_:5.2f}"
          f"  {fh_/fl_:6.2f}      {3*fl_:5.1f}   {ms[0][1]:.3f}/{ms[-1][1]:.3f}")

## HERA — Step 3c: low-field onset extension (`sdh-spot-check`), n = +3.2×10¹² at D = 0, B 0.2 → 1.2 T fine

> **05:29** · sdh-spot-check low-field onset extension: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0.2->1.2 T at 4 mT (251 pts), delay 0, sr1 50 uV; ends at 1.2 T · **ETA ~05:54** (≈25 min)

Run 6's carrying tone (7.1 T, the ABAB-light candidate) is **censored at the analysis edge**: below 1 T that record is a 50 mT grid — under-Nyquist for a 7.1 T tone below ~0.7 T, so its sub-1 T persistence is alias-suspect and the true onset is unpinned between 0.3 and ~1 T. `landau-fan` step 1 makes this binding: a censored carrying tone gets a cheap low-field extension before the fan, because B_lo drives the fan's row count (uniform-1/B puts ~half the rows below 1 T if B_lo = 0.5). This 25-minute sweep decides up to ~2.5 h of fan cost.

Design: same spot as run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹², D = 0 → V_tg +0.984, V_bg +1.166, run-5 cal), B **0.2 → 1.2 T at 4 mT** (Δ(1/B) = 0.044 T⁻¹ at 0.3 T ≤ 1/(3×7.1) — Nyquist×3 on the tone at the window's low edge), delay 0 (3 s driver settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s), sr1 50 µV — settings inherited from run 6, finer grid = grid-change alias screen in the 1–1.2 T overlap. Magnet sits at 0 T; ascends, ends at 1.2 T where the fan starts. Read: `sdh_onset` on the record → the fan's B_lo = measured onset (fan lands as the next cell). Checkpoint: first ~20 points (signal, leakage, field tracking).

# === Low-field onset extension (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0, B 0.2 -> 1.2 T, 4 mT ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: starts near 0), "
      f"V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}, "
      f"nplci tg/bg = {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1)")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1

B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.2, 1.2001, 0.004), 4)   # 251 pts, 4 mT
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check low-field onset extension: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} (run-5 cal), "
                  f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.2 -> 1.2 T, 4 mT, sr1 50 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field onset extension, electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; '
              f'(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); B 0.2 -> 1.2 T uniform-B 4 mT; '
              f'pins the onset of the run-6 censored 7.1 T tone -> fan B_lo')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 1.2 T — the fan starts from here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
